kai_dev: quick heads-up — I pushed a short-lived probe that emits kselect decisions + a KV-prefetch scoring field. Seeing a small but consistent latency bump (~6-10%) for requests around seqlen=128 on a40-gpu pools. dump below.

kai_dev: ```
# probe flags I used locally
RUNTIME_KSELECT_EXPLAIN=1
KSELECT_PREFETCH_SCORE_LOG=1
KSELECT_PREFETCH_SAMPLER=0.05  # sampling to avoid full churn
KSELECT_BUCKETS=8,16,32,64,128,256
LOG_FORMAT=json
```

maria_h: can you paste the grep/span id so i can cross-check with traces? is this only on model-v3 or across variants? :thinking_face:

kai_dev: span id: 0x7f3a2c  — grep command I used: `jq -r '.records[] | select(.kselect.prefetch_score != null) | [.ts,.req_id,.kselect.kernel,.kselect.prefetch_score,.kselect.reason] | @tsv' logs.json | grep 128`
It's most visible on v3-small and v3-medium; v2 seems unaffected.

daveb: nice. to limit noise set PREFETCH_SAMPLER=0.02 and add `KSELECT_EXPLAIN_TAG=kselect.explain` so traces pick it up. Also add a metric name like `kselect.prefetch.score` so we can chart it in datadog. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: ALERT: kernel_latency.p50 crossed 150ms threshold for model-v3-small canary at 2026-03-17T12:03Z — +8% vs baseline (rule:kern-latency-spike).

maria_h: good catch. i'll spin a canary with `KSELECT_PREFETCH_SCORE_LOG=0` (disable prefetch scoring) and compare p50/p95 for seqlen buckets. if regressions disappear -> prefetch scoring path is culprit.

kai_dev: will also add a debug env that forces the older kernel pick for seqlen=128 so we can A/B w/o changing traffic. command i used to re-run a trace locally: `./runtime_test --replay logs/replay-0x7f3a2c --env RUNTIME_KSELECT_OVERRIDE=old_kernel`

daveb: when you have the canary results, upload flamegraphs and sample kv-cache hit-rate per bucket. my hunch: prefetch score math interacts poorly with kv warmup for mid-lengths, causing extra memcopies or a different GEMM path.

kai_dev: attached traces/flamegraphs: https://s3.redwood-internal/probes/2355556789/{trace.json,flame-128.svg} — i'll update the dashboard with `kselect.prefetch.score` and `kselect.choice` tags.

maria_h: thanks. if we confirm, let's add a feature-flag gated autotune that lowers prefetch weight for archs matching "a40" and seqlen bucket 128. also add a low-sample per-minute log to keep long-term telemetry but avoid log blowup.

kai_dev: agree. i'll open a tiny RFC and a canary plan. short term: PREFETCH_SAMPLER=0.01 in prod; longer: autotune rule.

daveb: sounds good. ping me once RFC is up and i'll add perf-test harness to run net-new kernels with microbenchmarks.

perf-bot: NOTE: Created ticket PERF-1428 for tracking canary and autotune work.

kai_dev: thanks all :rocket:
